source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC09 and its encounter notes. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

fall.text: Tavo falls through a broken wall. Sena's bird tumbles beside him. His fingers close around it; feathers follow the arm. His body becomes an eagle.

hint.text: Fly to the bright perch before your wings tire. Hold a finger, or the mouse, where you want to go; arrow keys steer too. Flight assist in the pause menu widens the landings.

voice.speaker: VOICE
voice.caption: [an unfamiliar voice]
voice.text: Left. The air comes up there.

land.text: He lands human. Nali has seen everything.

land.speaker: TAVO
land.text: Tell me that happens to couriers.
Kesi steps out of the stair shadow, now human.

land.speaker: KESI
land.text: You could have landed badly enough to keep the wings.
